description: Prepare the nightly Analyse-Agent for this tenant: provision_agent «Analyse-Agent» (values, skill «Naechtliche Analyse», permissions get_analysepaket/record_ersparnis/save_agent_bericht/fetch_unmut_offen/record_unmut) and a cron schedule row for the tenant's dev-agent runner (dev_agent_session_schedules, default 05:45 Europe/Zurich, engine claude, session key analyse-agent, fresh session every night). Without ausfuehren:true it only returns the plan (agent arguments, runner found, schedule row) and changes nothing. Optional: runner_id, user_id (runner owner; default: found from WhatsApp route / earlier schedules), uhrzeit (HH:MM). Admins (humans) only.

ausfuehren.description: true applies the setup; otherwise only the plan is returned

name: setup_analyse_agent
